name: Enable Expert Mode in OpenBCI GUI
description:
The OpenBCI GUI is running an active Synthetic EEG session. Expert Mode unlocks additional controls including keyboard shortcuts for toggling individual EEG channels (keys 1-8) and other advanced features.

Your task is to enable Expert Mode:

1. Look for the settings or options button — this is typically a gear icon, hamburger menu (≡), or a button labeled 'Expert Mode' somewhere in the GUI interface.
2. The Expert Mode toggle may be found in:
   - A dropdown or hamburger menu (often in the top-right area of the GUI)
   - A settings panel that appears when you click the gear icon
   - A dedicated button labeled 'Expert Mode' in the interface
3. Click to enable Expert Mode. Note that OpenBCI GUI v5.2.2 does not display a visible on-screen indicator when Expert Mode is active — the setting is saved internally.

After enabling Expert Mode:
- The key 'm' will take a screenshot and save it to ~/Documents/OpenBCI_GUI/Screenshots/
- Additional keyboard shortcuts and controls become available
